### Contributing guidelines

- [X] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

### Module(s)

mini.pick

### Question

I couldn't really make sense of this from the docs, and maybe it's the ignorance of not needing such a thing before.

I get that marking multiple items will open them in a quickfix list. 👍🏻 

What I don't get is how to mark files and how to then generate the list.

I am finding myself grepping (using `grep_live` picker) for something that I end up needing many files in that search preserved.  So either it'd be beneficial to have a "use last picker" feature, or to use the mark/quickfix list route.

I have tried searching, the most relevant was someone asking how to open the marked files in their own buffers instead of a quickfix, but I also don't know how much of their config was theirs vs. what's necessary to make the feature/option work.

comment_data.body:
> What I don't get is how to mark files ...

Make an item current and execute ["Mark" action](https://nvim-mini.org/mini.nvim/doc/mini-pick.html#minipick-actions-built-in-mark), which is `<C-x>` by default. It is also possible to mark all present matches with `mark_all`, which is `<C-a>` by default.

> ... and how to then generate the list.

Execute ["Choose marked" action](https://nvim-mini.org/mini.nvim/doc/mini-pick.html#minipick-source.choose_marked). By default with `<M-CR>`. What it does exactly depends on how it is defined in picker's source, but the [default one](https://nvim-mini.org/mini.nvim/doc/mini-pick.html#minipick.default_choose_marked) indeed tries to detect common types of items that is reasonable to send to quickfix (like paths/buffers with/without positions).

> So either it'd be beneficial to have a "use last picker" feature

This is also possible with [builtin `resume` picker](https://nvim-mini.org/mini.nvim/doc/mini-pick.html#minipick.builtin.resume). Executing `:Pick resume` will open a latest picker at the state it was closed.

---

The example of marking and sending to quickfix is also [shown in the demo](https://nvim-mini.org/mini.nvim/readmes/mini-pick.html#demo) (at about 35 seconds).
